scientific.integrity: The controlled system, Hamiltonian, theorem, terminal conditions, and reported control formulas were inspected in the primary full text. The correction was independently reconstructed by symbolic differentiation and a terminal expansion, with an exact replay in the bundled checker. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The correction concerns the published first costate equation. It does not reconstruct unavailable implementation code or recompute the numerical optimal-control trajectories.

title: Correcting the susceptible costate in a vaccinated SEIR optimal-control model
